text: You have never seen him! He is the bonniest, sweetest little fellow that can be! What do you mean?" "I should have thought that the Squire would have desired a better-born heir than the offspring of a servant,--with all his ideas about descent and blood and family. And I should have thought that it was a little mortifying to Roger--who must naturally have looked upon himself as his brother's heir--to find a little interloping child, half French, half English, stepping into his shoes!"
